messages:
Mira: Heads-up — noticed a jump in invoice-preview credits right after last night's deploy, lots of tenants showing "unknown_route" attribution.
Alex: saw that too. preview window token totals doubled for a subset. digging into ingest logs now.
Tariq: any config changes to edge headers? we had that rename PR a few days ago.
Mira: there was a change in the proxy to prefer X-Routing over X-Route-Id but it should have been feature-flagged. looks like some canary shards picked it up.
Alex: proxy logs show mixed headers in the wild:
```
X-Route-Id: tenant-789
X-Routing: tenant-789
X-Routing: tenant-101
```
Alex: so some requests had both, others only the new one. ingest normalized based on precedence which flipped unexpectedly.
Mira: ingest currently does precedence X-Route-Id > X-Routing. if proxy flips precedence we get duplicate/incorrect attribution and unknown_route buckets.
Tariq: proposed immediate mitigations:
 - restore original precedence via quick proxy rollback toggle (canary first)
 - ingest: emit a route_origin tag (legacy-header/new-header/mixed) and a header_variant metric
 - flag preview credits coming from unknown_route as provisional so they don't become final invoice lines until reconciled
Alex: agree. For ingest change I can implement extract logic like:```python
def extract_route(headers):
    legacy = headers.get('X-Route-Id')
    new = headers.get('X-Routing')
    if legacy and new and legacy != new:
        origin = 'mixed'
        route = legacy  # keep legacy deterministic for now
    else:
        origin = 'legacy' if legacy else ('new' if new else 'unknown')
        route = legacy or new or 'unknown_route'
    return route, origin
```
Mira: please also add route_origin tag values to all downstream billing events and to preview pipeline so DashOps can filter.
Tariq: second-order: add a short TTL/marker on provisional preview credits (24h) and an automated recon job that attempts to reassign based on later-filling header mappings.
Alex: instead of dropping tokens, mark them provisional=true in the preview ledger and exclude from final invoice export. recon job can flip provisional->final if mapping found within TTL.
DashOps: I'll add a temporary console card showing header-variant distribution (legacy/new/mixed/unknown), provisional-credit count by tenant, and a link to run the recon playbook job. will also create an alert: provisional-credit > 0.5% of daily tokens for any tenant.
ingest-bot: alert: route-tagging-anomaly detected (1746509999) — 198 events with missing route_resolution_id in last 10m.
Mira: pinging @SRE for visibility and to help with proxy canary rollback if needed.
SRE: we're on it. canary toggle ready to flip in us-west-2, will hold for 10m and monitor header-variant metric.
Alex: ETA on ingest PR ~2hrs, will include unit test for header-precedence and an integration test for downstream event tags.
Tariq: I'll stage the proxy toggle in canary then escalate to 20% if metric stabilizes. also adding rollback plan: toggle off -> run dedupe check job to ensure no double-counting.
Mira: note for postmortem: stricter rules for header renames (must include ingest compatibility shim + console metric before unflagging).
DashOps: dashboard card and alert added; webhook posts summary to this channel when provisional threshold crosses.
Alex: PRs opened: https://git.redwood/ingest/pulls/1423 (route_origin + provisional flag) and https://git.redwood/proxy/pulls/998 (canary toggle revert).
Tariq: proxy toggle live in us-west-2 canary. watching metrics.
Mira: thanks. once ingest emits route_origin we can run recon to reassign provisional credits and close this thread.
SRE: will coordinate the canary watch and help run dedupe if we flip.
Mira: filing a short checklist and timeline for the postmortem after recon completes. key lesson: surface any header changes in console before traffic flips.
Alex: will add unit/integration tests and a short dev guide note about header deprecations.
Mira: closing for now — followups in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
